## @kit/testing/jwt
export type SigningAlgorithm = 'RS256' | 'ES256' | 'EdDSA';
export interface SigningKey {
    alg: SigningAlgorithm;
    kid: string;
    privateKey: crypto.KeyObject;
    jwk: crypto.JsonWebKey & {
        kid: string;
        alg: string;
        use: string;
    };
}
export function signJwt(key: SigningKey, claims: Record<string, unknown>, header?: Record<string, unknown>): string
export function signingKey(alg: SigningAlgorithm, kid: string): SigningKey
